method.cache_interpretation: warm-cache; MariaDB query cache disabled per session
method.connection_policy: one persistent connection per variant for this scale

ordering_policy.variant_order: two_engine first on odd-numbered repetitions; innodb_only first on even-numbered repetitions

method.percentile_definition: nearest rank: sorted sample at ceil(0.95 * n), one-based rank
method.timing_definition: Client-observed nanoseconds from immediately before cursor.execute() through completion of cursor.fetchall(); connection setup, cursor creation, result digesting, EXPLAIN, and JSON encoding are excluded.
